pre_onset_reporting.method: Report observed raw date-placebo probabilities beside the Holm-adjusted probabilities for R, H, and F; do not alter the frozen statistic or verdict.

variants.name: zero as missing observation
variants.zero_treatment: skip per-asset likelihood and Kalman measurement update

zero_returns.scope: Rerun parameter estimation, filtering, R/H/F diagnostics, H1 surrogate/placebo checks, and H2 primary prediction. Keep source zero returns in the equal-weight target and stress series.

factor_aligned_direction_null.construction: Fix the leading rolling-covariance eigenvector and draw the other rank-minus-one directions uniformly in its orthogonal complement.
factor_aligned_direction_null.dependence: Circular 250-session block bootstrap over date-wise angle percentiles; report a 95% interval and integrated-autocorrelation effective sample size.
factor_aligned_direction_null.haar_reference: Retain the frozen Haar comparison as the original reference.

refit_aware_h2_uncertainty.method: At each original expanding-window refit, draw training blocks only from observations available before the cutoff, refit the logistic models, draw test blocks from the out-of-sample window, and recompute paired AUC levels and increments.
refit_aware_h2_uncertainty.scope_limit: This resamples logistic fitting and test observations; it does not refit the volatility filter or RLS state path.

outputs: precision and recall at a 5% alert rate

17_industry.source: Kenneth R. French Data Library, 17 Industry Portfolios Daily
17_industry.interpretation: Aggregation check using the same underlying U.S. stock universe; drawdown events overlap substantially with the ten-industry panel and do not add independent event power.

developed_ex_us_industry.decision: Do not substitute non-industry portfolios for an industry panel. The official Library lists U.S. industry portfolios; its daily developed ex-U.S. series are sorted by size and book-to-market, not industry.

subperiod_f_surrogate.adjustment: Holm across the two prespecified subperiod probabilities.

analyses.citation_policy: Add a citation only when its DOI and publisher record have been verified; omit unverified references.
